Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.wms

Class WmsStoreManager

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.AbstractManager
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.wms.WmsStoreManager
public class WmsStoreManager extends AbstractManager
GeoServer Cascading WMS Store REST API manager.

A WMS store lets GeoServer proxy layers from an external WMS server (Cascading WMS). Create a WMS store by registering the external server's GetCapabilities URL; then publish individual layers via the wmslayers API (WmsLayerManager).

      public WmsStore create(String workspaceName, CreateWmsStoreRequest request)
      Creates a new WMS store.
      Parameters:
      workspaceName - workspace name (required)
      request - create request (required; name + capabilitiesURL are mandatory)

      the created WMS store (fetched via GET after POST)
      Throws:

    • update

      public WmsStore update(String workspaceName, String storeName, UpdateWmsStoreRequest request)
      Updates a WMS store. Only the specified fields are changed (partial update).

      Attempting to rename the store (setting a different name in the request) returns 403 Forbidden. Use storeName to identify which store to update.

      Parameters:
      workspaceName - workspace name (required)
      storeName - name of the WMS store to update (required)
      request - update request (required; only non-null fields are sent)
      Returns:
      the updated WMS store (fetched via GET after PUT)
      Throws:
      InvalidParameterException - if workspaceName/storeName/request is null/empty
      WmsStoreNotFoundException - if no WMS store with the given name exists

    • delete

      public void delete(String workspaceName, String storeName)
      Deletes a WMS store. Uses recurse=false; returns 401 if the store has WMS layers. Use delete(String, String, boolean) with recurse=true to cascade-delete layers.
      Parameters:
      workspaceName - workspace name (required)
      storeName - WMS store name to delete (required)
      Throws:
      InvalidParameterException - if workspaceName or storeName is null/empty
      WmsStoreNotFoundException - if no WMS store with the given name exists (404)

    • delete

      public void delete(String workspaceName, String storeName, boolean recurse)
      Deletes a WMS store.
      Parameters:
      workspaceName - workspace name (required)
      storeName - WMS store name to delete (required)
      recurse - when true, cascade-deletes all associated WMS layers; when false, returns 401 if layers exist
      Throws:
      InvalidParameterException - if workspaceName or storeName is null/empty
      WmsStoreNotFoundException - if no WMS store with the given name exists (404)
